summary: Iteration 172 — BidVex Storage Auctions iter172 backend testing. Validated (1) the critical proxy-bid correctness fix (bid_record.amount = submitter intent, never auto-advance; 2-second dedup), (2) ~20 new admin/facility endpoints (promotion tiers + grant/revoke, facility suspend/unsuspend/reject/delete, auction pause/resume/edit/delete/override-winner/force-close, admin-create on behalf of facility, pickup-code verify/mark/regenerate, my-storage-deposits user endpoint), and (3) scheduler now runs 11 jobs incl. hourly process_expired_promotions. Combined run = 72 PASS / 1 SKIPPED across the 4 storage suites (test_storage_proxy_bug_iter172=6, test_storage_payment_deposit_iter170=10, test_storage_iter171_api=21, test_storage_iter172_api=35). 1 skip is the in-process MONGO/DB live cron run which I separately validated by hand: process_expired_promotions(db) returns {downgraded:0, per_collection:{listings:0, vehicle_listings:0, storage_auctions:0}} cleanly with no errors.

minor.issue: Pydantic V1 @validator decorators emit DeprecationWarning. Should migrate to @field_validator before V3.0 (carried over from iter170/171, not new).
Return-type signature is `-> bool` but actual SendGrid-not-configured fallback returns a dict. Carried over from iter171, non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, carried) Migrate /app/backend/models/storage_auction.py @validator → @field_validator for Pydantic V2 compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: PROXY-BID FIX VERIFIED: services/storage_auction_service.place_bid correctly attributes bid_record.amount to the SUBMITTER's own max_bid (their intent), never to a leader auto-advance. Confirmed by 6 in-memory mock tests covering: A=11 fresh wins; A=25 leads, B=12 → B record amount=12 NOT 13; A=25 leads, B=60 → B wins at 26 but B's record amount=60; A raises own ceiling 25→40 → record=40, current_bid unchanged; rapid X=50 twice → 2nd returns is_duplicate=True, only 1 record stored; full 4-step spec scenario.

RBAC discipline is consistent across 20+ new admin endpoints — _require_admin → 403 for non-admin; _require_verified_facility → 403/404 for buyer; _require_admin returns 404 for unknown auction/facility; missing-required-field returns 400 (override-winner requires winner_id+reason; verify-pickup requires pickup_code).

admin_create_storage_auction correctly bypasses verified-facility owner guard via Query(facility_id) + 404 on unknown facility, while reusing the same payload validation (unit_size, unit_type, time order, payment_method, deposit_required+amount).

Promotion endpoint storage-auctions/{id}/promote uses verified-facility guard (returns 403 for buyer). PI is created but not confirmed in test environment (we did not exercise as no facility-owned auction was bid through the buyer; per request, do not capture).

Pickup code lifecycle is sound: facility verify (404 invalid, 409 already-used), facility mark-picked-up (404 if not found or already used), admin regenerate (400 if non-sold, 404 unknown, 200 with new_code on sold).

my-storage-deposits enriches each deposit with auction_unit_number + facility_name via in-memory dict lookup (efficient, single $in query). Returns {total, deposits:[]}. Auth required (401 anonymous, 200 authenticated).

Scheduler registers 11 jobs (verified via /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). process_expired_promotions is hourly; downgrades expired promotions across listings + vehicle_listings + storage_auctions in a single update_many per collection. Direct DB invocation returns clean dict — no errors.

admin_pause_auction → resume cycle works against a real active charbel-owned auction in the DB (round-trip 200/200, status flips paused↔active). admin_resume_auction guards on status=paused (returns 404 'Auction not found or not paused' if not paused).

admin_edit_auction whitelists fields to update (unit_number, descriptions, reserve, starting, increment, payment_method, deposit_*, promotion_tier, end_time). Returns 400 'No valid fields to update' before doing the lookup if payload empty — note: this means a 400 is returned even when the auction_id is invalid, which is acceptable but the spec said 'validates 404 on unknown'; the 404 only fires when valid fields are present and id missing. Tested both paths.

admin_override_winner correctly enforces (a) winner_id + reason both required (400), (b) auction must exist (404), (c) target user must have a bid on this auction (400 'Target user has no bid on this auction').

rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. The previously-reported critical proxy-bug (storage proxy's bid_record was attributing the leader's auto-advance to the SUBMITTER, e.g. showing bidder_id=B amount=$13 after B bid max=$12 and looking like the system auto-outbid B on B's own bid) is FIXED in services/storage_auction_service.py. The fix ensures bid_record.amount = the submitter's own max_bid (their intent), never an auto-advance. The 2-second dedup window protects against rapid double-click duplicate records. All 6 spec-locked invariants now pass: (1) A=11 fresh → A wins, single record amount=11; (2) A=25 then B=12 → A still leads, B's record amount=12 (NOT 13), current_bid=13; (3) A=25 then B=60 → B wins, current_bid=26, B's record amount=60; (4) A=25 then A=40 → A still leads, current unchanged, A's latest record amount=40; (5) X=50 twice rapid → r2.is_duplicate=True, only 1 record; (6) full A=11/B=10/B=15 spec scenario.
